dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence with sharp pale boundaries visible on the distal edges of the folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct curvilinear boundary separates the finely speckled texture of the crown from the coarse, high-contrast scaling of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast black mask present in the loral and ocular region; exceptionally thick, pale blue-white conical bill.
